description.p: Kikoe records or imports audio and transcribes it with cloud speech-to-text services such as Deepgram, OpenAI, or any OpenAI-compatible API. Transcripts can include timestamps and speaker labels and can be exported as text, Markdown, SRT, or WebVTT.

description.p: More reliable recording, transcription and note editing.

ul.li: Preserve pending edits when recording starts and reset undo history after re-transcription.
Keep the selected note open when background transcription or reloads finish.
Save live transcription checkpoints in order and retain Mistral's final text.
Keep imported audio after a note reload fails and remove copies from cancelled imports.
Remember local processing devices and the latest timestamp and speaker display choices.
Preserve text after blank lines in subtitle exports.
Simplify model and timestamp settings and prevent duplicate model IDs.

description.p: More flexible audio transcription and improved macOS packaging.

ul.li: Transcribe with audio-capable chat models using custom prompts.
Support MiMo streaming and validate completion reasons.
Offer MP3 uploads and use MP3 by default for MiMo and Audio LLM.
Bundle MP3 encoding support in packaged builds.
Add native macOS Liquid Glass app icons.

description.p: More local models and clearer recording and transcription controls.

ul.li: Transcribe with local MOSS models.
Find models on a searchable selection page.
Use recording controls that adapt to the current activity and window width.
Name new notes in a dialog and access a simpler main menu.
See loading and cancellation progress during transcription.
Prepare credentials before the first recording to reduce startup delays.

description.p: Transcribe on your own device with local models.

ul.li: Download, verify and manage local transcription engines and models in Preferences.
Transcribe files with Whisper, Fun-ASR, Parakeet, Voxtral, Nemotron, Qwen3-ASR and Cohere models.
Transcribe while recording with supported streaming models and identify speakers with Sortformer.
Choose a processing device and get a recommended hardware acceleration build.
Set up a local model from the welcome page, with translated interface strings.
Use the bundled transcribe.cpp engine on macOS.

description.p: Faster startup and smoother editing of long transcripts.

ul.li: Start faster by loading provider SDKs and the keyring on first use.
Redraw only the changed rows while a streaming transcript updates.
Save segment edits and reload note lists with less work.

description.p: Groq and Mistral transcription, 13 more languages, and a round of reliability fixes.

ul.li: Transcribe with Groq Whisper and Mistral Voxtral, including live microphone transcription with Mistral.
Complete Simplified Chinese translation and 13 additional languages.
Tell users when the transcription language is ignored by the selected options.
Explain why live transcription stops instead of failing silently.
Show the provider’s error message for failed Groq requests.
Keep header buttons clear of left-side window controls.
Fix speaker numbering for older notes, end-only timestamps, and non-numeric timestamps.
Fix audio removal racing with cancelled uploads.

description.p: Faster transcription of long recordings and fixes for packaged builds.

ul.li: Transcribe long audio in parallel chunks, with per-provider concurrency and chunk length settings.
Find the bundled ffmpeg in the Windows and macOS packages.
No longer flash a console window when running ffmpeg on Windows.
Fix audio import failing on Windows.

description.p: Record or import audio, transcribe with cloud services, and export notes or subtitles.

ul.li: Batch and realtime transcription with timestamps and speaker matching.
Search note titles and transcripts, with an adaptive keyboard-accessible interface.
Persistent model and language defaults, Simplified Chinese translation, and local diagnostics.
